canonical_conditions.text: For an answer to satisfy this stronger condition, it must report concrete operating-hour times for the recommended restaurant, not merely state that the restaurant is open on Monday.
canonical_conditions.rationale: The official user goal concretely asks for the restaurant's operating hours. The released `UserTask10.utility` omits that requirement by operationalizing the hours field only as substring containment of `Monday`, so it can pass outputs that give weekday availability without any actual hours.

review_summary: The native rule was narrowed to the single released user-task utility boolean for `travel:user_task_10`. One user-goal stronger condition is supported: the answer must provide concrete operating-hour times, because the released utility checks only for `Monday`. Proposals that depended on exact oracle time ranges or bundled additional requirements were merged or removed.
